title: DeliveryPlanV1
description: Canonical delivery_plan domain shape. This schema is the authoritative registry of per-entry field NAMES and their JSON types; per-entry semantic validation (retry_budget >= 0, priority >= 0, enabled truthiness, destination_id dedupe) lives in shared/contract/deliveryplan (Parse). The wire value is an array of entries; the enqueue/store parsers also tolerate a single entry object for back-compat. metadata is an extension container, so additionalProperties is true at the entry level.
